text.tspan: S2 EPS rails and load switches
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · preliminary · dashed = part not selected (TBD) · TBR = value not confirmed
No regulator in the hardware documents takes a 4S input (finding F6): both are TBD, with input rated >= 25 V.
The 3V3 rail and the 3V3_AO rail are the same regulator in this drawing (TBR: a separate switched 3V3).
2.0 A nom · 3.5 A trip; to S7
0.5 A nom · 1.0 A trip; hardware TX-OFF
Every enable is low at reset and held low by its pull-down,
so a reset or an unprogrammed MCU leaves every load off.
SW3's pull-down is mandatory: it is the hardware TX-OFF
path (BASELINE 7), independent of the AI payload.
OBC + FRAM run from 3V3_AO directly (about 50 mA).
None of the switches' fault outputs reaches the OBC;
the INA226 ALERT (PB7) is the only interrupt (TBR).
